description: This Java class 'JSONRequestBodyMapHandler' implements the 'RequestBodyMapHandler' interface to extract a Map<String, Object> from JSON data present in the request body of a servlet request.

classes.name: JSONRequestBodyMapHandler
classes.description: A class that extracts a Map from JSON request body data by implementing RequestBodyMapHandler.

methods.name: extractMapFromRequestBody
methods.description: Extracts a Map<String, Object> from the input stream of a ServletRequest, parsing it from JSON.
